tasks.subject: Task 0: Nix flake, Cargo scaffold, vendored font, fulgur smoke test
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Nix dev shell where the crate builds/links and fulgur renders a PDF.

**Files:** flake.nix, .envrc, Cargo.toml, Makefile, .gitignore, src/lib.rs, src/main.rs, assets/fonts/DejaVuSerif*.ttf, tests/smoke.rs

**Verify:** `nix develop -c cargo test --test smoke`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["flake.nix", ".envrc", "Cargo.toml", "Makefile", "assets/fonts/DejaVuSerif.ttf", "tests/smoke.rs"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test --test smoke", "acceptanceCriteria": ["fulgur renders a PDF (links with libiconv)", "pdftoppm available in shell"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```
